prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's real 800 x 480 Klipper printing screen. Make ONE faithful recolored screenshot, full frame, flat and front-facing, same 5:3 aspect ratio, preferably 1600 x 960. Preserve the exact layout, spacing, button dimensions, shapes, rounded corners, typography, labels, filename, numbers, and all existing screen content. This is a minimal palette edit, not a redesign. No side-by-side variants, no external captions, no bezel, no device, no 3D, no gradients, no texture, no glow.

Apply exactly these changes:
1. All exposed full-screen background, outer margins and gutters: laboratory white #E8ECEB.
2. All card fills, six button-tile fills, left print-information panel fill, header-bar fill, and inset temperature-panel fills: graphite black #20272B.
3. EVERY functional interface icon must use the SAME solid steel grey #4B575D, regardless of its old color. Explicitly recolor the pause icon, cancel X in its circular icon, macro terminal icon, exclude layers icon, print-settings gear icon, stop-square circular icon, nozzle icon, heated-bed icon, Wi-Fi icon and connection-status dot to #4B575D. There are NO exceptions for dangerous actions: CANCELAR and PARADA must also have grey icons, NOT red. Preserve glyph cutouts in graphite #20272B. Preserve all original icon silhouettes and sizes.
4. EXCEPTION: keep actual pictures / illustrative images / logos in their ORIGINAL colors. The large central circular Aperture image is artwork, NOT a monochrome functional icon: preserve its exact original cyan/blue blades, black rim, black separators, shape and proportions. Do NOT turn it grey and do not reinterpret or redraw it.
5. Primary button-label text and numerical actual readings: laboratory white #E8ECEB. Keep the source text "APERTURE", "KLIPPER", "aperture_companion_cube.gcode", "NO DATA", "PROGRESO", "BOQUILLA", "CAMA", "PAUSAR", "CANCELAR", "MACROS", "EXCLUIR", "AJUSTES IMPRESION", "PARADA". Keep all labels in their original positions.
6. Title "IMPRIMIENDO", the numeric progress "63 %" and temperature target text "/210 °C" and "/60 °C" remain portal orange #FF8A1C, since those are text values, not icons. Actual readings stay "207" and "60" in laboratory white. Secondary text is light grey and readable on graphite. Panel borders thin neutral steel grey.
The final screenshot must contain NO colored functional icons anywhere: ALL small functional symbols are steel grey. Only the Aperture illustration keeps its original cyan, and text accents may be orange.
Preserve invariants aggressively: change only the specified colors; keep UI geometry and image artwork unchanged.
